description:
A Large fey sovereign who binds living briars into a walking court. It is an elite solo encounter meant to stress advanced stat block mechanics. Target challenge rating 11.

Vitality and defense: AC near 17 from natural armor; hit points around 170–190; walking speed 30 feet and fly 60 feet. High Wisdom and Charisma; moderate Dexterity and Constitution.

Spellcasting: innate spellcasting trait with a mix of at-will, per-day, and leveled groups (for example misty step at will, entangle and spike growth per day, and a small set of 4th-level slots for blight or similar). Spell save DC and attack bonus should match CR 11.

Recharge ability: a breath or wave attack (such as a cone of thorn-laced gale force) keyed to recharge 5–6 on a d6, with a clear save DC and damage dice.

Legendary actions: declare a legendary_actions resource pool (typically 3 per round) and at least two legendary action options that spend from that pool—one movement or utility option and one attack or area denial option. Multiattack on the main action economy if appropriate.

Do not include lair actions unless you also add a full lair profile with initiative timing; legendary actions and spell groups are the priority.
